title: Dr. Ahmed Hamidu Kara, born on August 31, 1968, in Gembu, Nigeria, is a distinguished medical professional with a rich educational background, including an M.B.B.S. from the University of Maiduguri. He has held various positions in the medical field, including serving as a physician to the Taraba State Government and rising through the ranks at the Government House Clinic. Dr. Kara has been actively involved in numerous state responsibilities, including leadership roles in the Nigerian Medical Association and organizing health-related events. He is also known for initiating the first HIV/AIDS Comprehensive Centre in Taraba State. Currently, he is pursuing an MBA at the Federal University of Technology, Yola, and is happily married with children.
